title: application errors
description: Application error shape and code catalog. Application codes live outside the JSON-RPC reserved range (-32768..-32000), grouped by domain: 1xxx daemon, 2xxx ACP session, 3xxx propose, 4xxx worktree orchestration. Contract messages are in English; the remedy field lets surfaces translate or expand.

kind.description: Machine-readable error kind, stable across daemon versions.

detail.description: Human-readable English detail of what went wrong.

remedy.description: Actionable English suggestion for how to fix it.

errorObject.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object with structured data.

1000.description: The client declared a proto/ contract version the daemon does not support. detail carries both the requested and the supported versions; the connection is closed after the response.

1001.description: A method other than initialize was called before a successful initialize on this connection.

1002.description: The daemon is shutting down and no longer accepts work.

2000.description: Neither agent.command nor agent.id is configured. remedy points to the user or project config file.

2001.description: The selected agent is not present on this system: the configured catalog id is unknown, or its binary was not detected. detail names the missing id or command; remedy explains how to configure or install it. Nothing is launched.

2002.description: The agent subprocess could not be started.

2003.description: The ACP initialize negotiation with the agent failed. On version incompatibility, detail carries both protocol versions; the subprocess is terminated.

2004.description: The given sessionId does not correspond to an active session.

3000.description: The derived change name already exists under .meltemi/changes/. detail includes the conflicting name; remedy suggests an available alternative. Nothing is modified.

3001.description: No change name can be derived from the given idea.

3002.description: projectRoot does not exist or is not a directory.

4000.description: Worktree orchestration was requested on a directory that is not a git repository. detail states the directory is not a git repo; remedy points to `git init` (or opening an existing repo). Simple sessions still work, without isolation, warned.

4001.description: A managed-worktree or checkpoint operation was refused: the target is not one the daemon created, it has uncommitted changes, or the required confirmation was not given. Foreign worktrees are never touched; dirty removals and reversions need explicit confirmation.

4002.description: No checkpoint exists for the requested change/task/agent. detail names the missing task; remedy suggests listing checkpoints. Nothing is reverted.

4003.description: The per-task commit could not be created — most often a user git hook rejected it. detail carries the git/hook output verbatim; hooks are never bypassed (no --no-verify). The task stays completed-without-commit, a visible state.

4004.description: Archiving was blocked: a requirement is neither verified (linked to a test or manually marked) nor excepted with a justification. detail lists the unverified scenarios; nothing is folded into the living truth.

4005.description: Archiving was blocked: applying the change's deltas to the living truth raised conflict diagnostics (e.g. a modified requirement that does not exist). detail lists them; nothing is folded — the living truth is left intact.
